result.requirement: The system shall enable the Merchandiser to create, update, and archive product catalog entries while enforcing data validation and version control.
result.business_need: The business needs a structured way to manage product lifecycle data to ensure accurate inventory representation and prevent overselling.
functional_behaviour: The system shall allow the Merchandiser to add new items to the Product Catalog with required attributes.
The system shall allow the Merchandiser to modify existing item details and automatically archive the previous version.
The system shall validate input data against defined business rules before saving any catalog changes.
The system shall maintain a history of all product changes for audit and rollback purposes.
The system shall prevent the modification of archived product versions to ensure data integrity.
business_rules: A product entry cannot be updated if it is in an archived state.
All product updates must include a timestamp and the identifier of the user making the change.
Required fields such as product name and price must be populated before a new entry is created.
Previous versions of a product must be retained and marked as archived when a new version is published.

acceptance_criteria.given: The Merchandiser is logged in and views the Product Catalog
acceptance_criteria.when: The Merchandiser submits a new product entry with all required fields filled
acceptance_criteria.then: The system creates the new entry, assigns it as the current version, and displays a success message

acceptance_criteria.given: The Merchandiser attempts to update a product entry with a missing required field
acceptance_criteria.when: The Merchandiser submits the update request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the request and displays an error message indicating the missing field
